FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Restrict weapon filtering
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds some restrictions to how weapons are filtered across the mod.

patchNoteLines.li: Add "WeaponUnique" to the category blocklist of the weapons resource, thus blocking unique weapons from being tithed
Block unique weapons from appearing in the weapon selection list for created military units

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
